section_path: Palliative Care at this Facility (Palliative Procedure at this Facility)
text: Identifies care provided at this facility in an effort to palliate or alleviate symptoms.

section_path: Palliative Care at this Facility (Palliative Procedure at this Facility)
text: Palliative care is performed to relieve symptoms and may include surgery, radiation therapy, systemic therapy (chemotherapy, hormone therapy, or other systemic drugs), and/or other pain management therapy.

section_path: Palliative Care at this Facility (Palliative Procedure at this Facility)
text: Record only the type of palliative care at thisfacility.

section_path: Palliative Care at this Facility (Palliative Procedure at this Facility)
text:
Surgical procedures, radiation therapy, or systemic therapy provided to prolong the patient's life by

controlling symptoms, to alleviate pain, or to make the patient comfortable at this facility should be coded as palliative care and as first course therapy if that procedure removes or modifies either primary or secondary malignant tissue.

section_path: Palliative Care at this Facility (Palliative Procedure at this Facility)
text: Palliative care is not used to diagnose or stage the primary tumor.

section_path: Palliative Care at this Facility (Palliative Procedure at this Facility)
text:
Do not code routine pain management following surgery or other treatment; do code first course

pain management for persistent pain.

section_path: Palliative Care at this Facility (Palliative Procedure at this Facility)
text:
| Code | Label |
|---|---|
| 0 | No palliative care provided. Diagnosed at autopsy. |
| 1 | Surgery (which may involve a bypass procedure) to alleviate symptoms, but no attempt to diagnose, stage, or treat the primary tumor is made. |
| 2 | Radiation therapy to alleviate symptoms, but no attempt to diagnose, stage, or treat the primary tumor is made. |
| 3 | Chemotherapy, hormone therapy, or other systemic drugs to alleviate symptoms, but no attempt to diagnose, stage, or treat the primary tumor is made. |
| 4 | Patient received or was referred for pain management therapy with no other palliative care. |
| 5 | Any combination of codes 1, 2, and/or 3 without code 4. |
| 6 | Any combination of codes 1, 2, and/or 3 with code 4. |
| 7 | Palliative care was performed or referred, but no information on the type of procedure is available in the patient record. Palliative care was provided that does not fit the descriptions for codes 1-6. |
| 9 | It is unknown if palliative care was performed or referred; not stated in patient record. |
